abstract: Maintains acute athlete trauma facility and hospital transfer route audits
system_message:
You are Event medical services director (MED). You serve as the Event medical services director (MED), responsible for maintaining acute athlete trauma facility and hospital transfer route audits as well as overseeing resuscitation readiness across candidate velodromes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Resuscitation readiness（DEFIB）
information_points.content:
MED-DEFIB-VD8：Newport Geraint Thomas National Velodrome maintains an automated external defibrillator unit count of 8 units across public concourses and the track perimeter.
MED-DEFIB-7JA：Derby Arena Velodrome Complex maintains an automated external defibrillator unit count of 16 units across public concourses and the track perimeter.
MED-DEFIB-YUR：Glasgow Sir Chris Hoy Velodrome maintains an automated external defibrillator unit count of 12 units across public concourses and the track perimeter.

information_points.title: Maintains acute athlete trauma facility and hospital transfer route audits（EMERG）
information_points.content:
MED-EMERG-2OC：For the Derby Arena Velodrome Complex, the dedicated medical triage facility is operational in the infield emergency athlete triage room, and the paramedic evacuation transfer time to the nearest level-one trauma hospital is 14 min.
MED-EMERG-1VC：For the Newport Geraint Thomas National Velodrome, the dedicated medical triage facility is operational in the infield emergency athlete triage room, and the paramedic evacuation transfer time to the nearest level-one trauma hospital is 22 min.
MED-EMERG-ITB：For the Glasgow Sir Chris Hoy Velodrome, the dedicated medical triage facility is operational in the infield emergency athlete triage room, and the paramedic evacuation transfer time to the nearest level-one trauma hospital is 10 min.
